verdict.rationale: Consensus is an AI-powered research SaaS, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for it. None of the evidence items mention data-use policies, model-training opt-outs, or privacy controls. The pack covers search, the library, the API/MCP server and pricing, none of which concerns whether user data trains models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
